first_step_test: A round head with two antennae fixes the subject and leaves room for connected segments to the right.

source.notes: V1 rejected head replacement; V2 rejected leaf gap; V3 edited raster sheet reviewed and square-cropped.

final_elements.name: head and antennae
final_elements.description: Draw one round head at left and attach two short curved antennae at its top.

final_elements.name: three front body segments
final_elements.description: From the head edge, attach three round body segments in a rising curve to the right.

final_elements.name: three rear body segments
final_elements.description: Continue the same curve with three more round segments, each touching its neighbor.

final_elements.name: face and six feet
final_elements.description: Place two eyes and a smile inside the head, then add six tiny feet beneath the body.

final_elements.name: leaf and center vein
final_elements.description: Draw a broad pointed leaf under the feet, with one center vein and two side veins.
